_comment: Rows on the raid utility page that are cast by a PET or a BUILD, not by the player. db.exil.es files these under the owning class's spell list, so they arrived on the page looking like class buttons -- Tinker showed a 25 second interrupt on every spec, and the 25 seconds belongs to a gameobject nobody can command. Each entry names the button the player actually presses; the page renders that button and keeps the pet ability as a chip.
_the_tell: gcd_ms 0 alone is NOT the signal -- pet abilities inside a kit vary (Rusthound's Rustbite is gcd 1500, its Meltdown is gcd 0). What identifies one is `skill_line` naming a pet or a build rather than a spec tree, cross-checked against a `Build:` / `Summon:` / `Call` button in the same class's list. Both halves are needed: Stormbringer's `Electrifying Aura` has skill_line `Lightning`, and Lightning is a real Stormbringer SPEC.

_control.none: No action bar exists. A summoned GAMEOBJECT firing on a timer. The player controls placement and nothing else.
_control.pet-bar: A pet with a multi-ability kit, so a pet action bar exists. Whether THIS ability is manually castable or autocast-only is NOT in either database -- that flag lives in pet spell data, not spell_template. Needs an in-game look.
_control.passive: An aura the pet carries. Nothing to press; the requirement is that the pet is out.

_cd_from: Which cooldown gates the row. `button` when the summon is TEMPORARY -- the Noise Box exists for 15 seconds out of every 90, so 90 is the number a raid plans around. `ability` when the pet is permanent, where the button costs nothing to keep up and the pet ability's own cooldown is the gate.
_checked: 2026-08-03, from spell effects and skill lines on db.exil.es. No in-game verification yet -- see `control: pet-bar`.

560470.how: Build: Noise Box (807723) is effect 28 with misc_value 52036 -- it summons a GAMEOBJECT, not a pet, so no action bar for it exists. Noise Box Aura (807742) is aura 23 PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, amplitude 3000ms, radius 8 yd, duration 15s: five ticks three seconds apart at whatever enemy is near the box. The player picks where and when, and nothing after that.
560470.raid_note: GONE. It was never targeted interrupt coverage and now it is not coverage at all: the box that cast it is not in the game. Tinker's interrupt column is Meltdown alone.
560470.confirmed_absent: Build: Noise Box was checked in game 2026-08-03 and is NOT there, so this row no longer renders -- resources/icon-missing.json confirmed_absent carries the record. Kept here because the mapping is still true and re-deriving it cost a day: db.exil.es files Distracto Shot under Tinker's own spell list, so without this entry it comes back as a 25 second class interrupt on every spec.

581313.how: The Rusthound is permanent (Build: Rusthound has no cooldown, 'until dismissed') and carries a four-ability kit -- Rustbite 2s, Manabite 8s, Seek 30s, Meltdown 30s -- so it has a pet action bar.
581313.raid_note: The only Tinker interrupt that could be fired on command, and it is 5 YARD range: the hound must already be in melee of the target. Manual-cast vs autocast-only is unverified.

806173.how: skill_line `Scrapmaw`, which is Build: Scrapmaw (500242) -- a permanent build with a two-ability kit (Drill Smash 30s, Missile Swarm 20s).
806173.raid_note: 5 yard range, and a stun, so trash only either way.

800013.how: skill_line `Pet - Mindbender`. Summon: Mindbender (803062) is a permanent minion, 40% mana, no cooldown. The tooltip narrates the pet doing it: 'The Mindbender teleports to an enemy and channels on them'.
800013.raid_note: 30 yd, but a 3 second channel by the pet, and a stun.

801599.how: skill_line `Pet - Dinomancy Devilsaur`. Call Avatar: Devilsaur (801585) summons it, and the class can only have one Avatar at a time.
801599.raid_note: A raid haste buff that depends on which Avatar the Witch Doctor is running.

804067.how: skill_line `Pet - Wind Servant`. An aura the Air Elemental carries: 15% less AoE damage taken by party members within 20 yds. No cooldown, nothing to press.
804067.raid_note: Real, but it is 20 yds around the ELEMENTAL and requires the Stormbringer to be running that summon (75% mana).
